name: Tuna Fried Rice
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 cup basmati rice, prepared as a firm and dry pilav
½ cup or more shredded cabbage

steps: Prepare a pilaf-style rice. This should be dry with little fat or excess moisture.
Sauté the onion in 1 tbsp olive oil.
Add the cabbage and bean sprouts.
Stir in red pepper paste and paprika.
Add the miso and honey, and combine thoroughly.
Move the rice to one side of the skillet and crack in the eggs.
When they are ready, mix the scrambled eggs in with the rice.
Garnish with katsuobushi and scallions before serving.
